name: Feather Token (Anchor)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Use
powers.text: Touch it to a boat or ship: the vessel can't be moved for 24 hours.

summary: Touch it to a boat or ship: the vessel can't be moved for 24 hours.
text: A single-use token shaped like a feather. As a Magic action, press it against a boat or ship: for the next 24 hours nothing can move the vessel. Pressing the token to the vessel again ends this early, and the token vanishes once the effect is over.
